description: No charge. Render an unsaved two-page postcard proof (artwork front and address reverse) for postcardType:single_sided (5.5 × 4.25) or double_sided (8.5 × 5.5) from an owned email id, attachment index, edited message and US from/to addresses. For saved generated artwork use attachment:generated and its exact artworkId. JPG/PNG/WebP images fill the front with centered cropping; PDFs must be one unrotated page matching the selected size. Small cards print the image and message together on the front; the reverse is address-only. Large cards print the message beside the address on the back. Text is limited to 1200 characters and must fit; shorten overflowing text. Omit postcardType to use the email snapshot. Returns a private embedded PDF resource; postage/address marks are illustrative. Workspace authentication and OAuth mcp:read required; staging may preview. No saved quote, external artwork upload, payment or mailing.
name: preview_email_postcard
title: Preview Email Postcard
